title: Release of Sub-Sectoral Trial Index of Services Production (ISP) for August 2026 (Base Year 2024–25)
body_text: The Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) releases the Index of Services Production (ISP) for the month of August 2026 in respect of 19 sub-sectors, with base year 2024–25. Sub – Sector wise trends in ISPs in August, 2026 over August, 2025 are given below: S. No. Broad Sub -Sector ISP August, 2026 Growth in August, 2026 over August, 2025 1 Wholesale Trade 122.9 10.2 2 Retail Trade 139.2 19.9 3 Repair Services 130.7 17.6 4 Accommodation and food 145.3 11.9 5 Railway Transport 105.6 3.7 6 Road Transport 128.4 9.4 7 Water Transport 109.1 9.5 8 Air Transport 89.2 -9.6 9 Warehousing and support activities for transportation 126.8 11.2 10 Postal and Courier 114.3 13.2 11 Telecommunications 120.7 11.8 12 Information and Broadcasting 98.6 7.2 13 Banking 125.0 14.9 14 Insurance 107.9 16.5 15 Real Estate 115.3 17.6 16 IT and computer related services 116.4 13.8 17 Professional, scientific & technical services including R & D 112.7 14.2 18 Administrative and support services 118.8 13.1 19 Arts, Entertainment and Recreation Services 111.7 -4.7 The month wise indices for the above sub-sectors from August 2025 are given in Annexure. Notes: The monthly ISPs are being published on an experimental basis. The publication of Trial Series would enable MoSPI to examine data quality, test its resilience and also receive feedback of stakeholders and users. The Indices of Railways, Banking and Insurance sub – sectors, are based on provisional monthly data and would undergo revision on an annual basis. This Press Release is also available at the Ministry’s Website - http://www.mospi.gov.in .
